Totally get it—picking the right stuff can feel like staring at a huge restaurant menu.

Here are a few ways to narrow things down:

Browse products & ingredients: When you click on any product before adding it to your box, you can see ingredients, nutrition, sourcing details, and whether it’s gluten-free or includes any of the 9 major allergens. This is super helpful if you’re trying to eat cleaner or avoid certain ingredients.
Think about how you cook: We offer everything from thick-cut steaks to gluten-free chicken nuggets and other specialty, fully cooked items—great if you want quick weeknight options.
Look for deals: If you’re a member, sign in and check the DEALS tab in your account to see exclusive member offers you can add to your next box. New folks can see sign-up promotions on our homepage and at checkout.
Want this as a gift instead? You can also choose from one-time gift boxes or eGift cards if you’re shopping for someone else.
Prefer to grab a few things in person? Some of our cuts are also available in Target stores nationwide (fresh in the meat case) and select Costco locations in the Pacific Northwest (frozen breakfast items).
Need cooking inspiration first? You can browse recipes and tips on our recipe and blog pages to match cuts with the kinds of meals you actually like to make.

If you tell me a bit about how you like to eat (quick meals vs. big weekend cooking projects, any dietary needs, budget), I can walk you through what to prioritize from there using these options.
